datasets.name: DEMNAS — Indonesian National Digital Elevation Model

access.method: Ina-Geoportal download per RBI 1:50k sheet; owner uploads to private draft release 'demnas-private'

citation.text: Badan Informasi Geospasial (BIG). DEMNAS: Seamless Digital Elevation Model Nasional, v1.0. https://tanahair.indonesia.go.id

datasets.notes: Format verified 2026-10-24 from BIG's own DEMNAS description (sent by the owner: 0.27 arc-second, EGM2008, geographic, GeoTIFF float32; files DEMNAS_xxxx-yy-v1.0.tif per RBI 1:50k sheet, xxxx-yyy for 1:25k) and from the owner's upload (25 sheets; 6 inside the Jakarta domain, mosaicked by demnas.yml). Licence still unverified: kept out of the public site. DSM/DTM behaviour in dense urban areas to be compared with FABDEM in Phase 2. Tile list: data/demnas/jakarta_tiles.json.
